# Stanford Environmental Health & Safety

> Stanford EHS provides comprehensive environmental health and safety services, training, and resources to protect Stanford University's research and workplace environments.

Stanford Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) is the university's central resource for occupational health, laboratory safety, radiation protection, biosafety, environmental compliance, and emergency preparedness. The department serves researchers, faculty, staff, and students across Stanford's campus through training programs, consulting services, and safety equipment.

## Key Topics

- Environmental Health & Safety
- Laboratory Safety
- Biosafety & Biosecurity
- Radiation Safety
- Fire Safety
- Chemical Waste Management
- Safety Training
- Occupational Health
- Emergency Management
- Workplace Ergonomics
- Environmental Protection
- Standard Operating Procedures
- ChemTracker
- STARS Platform
- Incident Reporting

## Core Services & Programs

- [Stanford Environmental Health & Safety](https://ehs.stanford.edu): Main homepage for Stanford EHS with overview of safety services and programs
- [Services](https://ehs.stanford.edu/services): Overview of Stanford EHS services including waste management and hazard consultation
- [About Us](https://ehs.stanford.edu/about-us): Organization overview, mission, structure, and leadership of Stanford EHS
- [Environmental Protection](https://ehs.stanford.edu/about-us/environmental-protection): Environmental Protection Programs covering waste, hazmat, and spill response
- [Safety Store](https://ehs.stanford.edu/safety-store): EHS safety equipment and supplies ordering and pickup location

## Safety Training & Education

- [Training Courses](https://ehs.stanford.edu/training): Safety training courses and educational programs via STARS and SNOW platforms
- [Learning Library](https://ehs.stanford.edu/learning-library): Video resources and training materials for workplace safety and best practices
- [Guides & Manuals](https://ehs.stanford.edu/manual): Comprehensive guides, manuals, and best practices for EHS compliance
- [Standard Operating Procedures](https://ehs.stanford.edu/standard-operating-procedure): SOP templates, Chemical Hygiene Plan guidance, and lab safety procedures

## Specialized Safety Programs

- [Biosafety & Biosecurity](https://ehs.stanford.edu/topic/biosafety-biosecurity): Biosafety requirements, IBC oversight, and BMBL compliance guidelines
- [Radiation Safety](https://ehs.stanford.edu/topic/radiation-safety): Radiation safety, health physics, and authorization requirements for radioactive materials
- [Fire Safety](https://ehs.stanford.edu/topic/fire-safety): Fire safety, extinguisher training, and emergency preparedness information
- [Ergonomics](https://ehs.stanford.edu/topic/ergonomics): Ergonomics program with workspace evaluation and equipment setup guidance

## Support & Resources

- [Contact Us](https://ehs.stanford.edu/contact): Contact information and emergency hotlines for EHS services and reporting
- [Staff Directory](https://ehs.stanford.edu/staff): Staff directory and contact information for EHS department personnel
- [Stanford Login](https://ehs.stanford.edu/saml_login): SAML authentication login page for Stanford EHS system access

## Optional

- [Classic Homepage](https://ehs.stanford.edu/homepage/classic-homepage): Archive of classic homepage with announcements and historical content
